description: Grade video clips with Lumetri Color (Window > Lumetri Color): set Basic Correction (Input LUT, white balance, tone), Creative (Look, intensity, faded film, vibrance, tints), Color Wheels & Match, HSL Secondary corrections and Vignette settings by their display names, or any Lumetri parameter by index. Adds a Lumetri Color effect to clips that have none. Values as list_clip_effects reports them. One undo step, two when an effect is added

add.description: Add a Lumetri Color effect to clips without one. Default true

additionalProperties.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

basic.description: Basic Correction: settings by display name, e.g. Input LUT, HDR White, Temperature, Tint, Saturation, Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks

byIndex.description: Lumetri parameters by index (from list_clip_effects), for any setting the sections do not name

value.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

clearKeyframes.description: Turn animation off for animated settings given (removes their keyframes). Default false

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

component.description: Index of the Lumetri Color effect to set (from list_clip_effects). Default: the clip's first Lumetri Color

additionalProperties.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

creative.description: Creative: settings by display name, e.g. Look, Intensity, Faded Film, Sharpen, Vibrance, Saturation, Shadow Tint, Highlight Tint, Tint Balance

additionalProperties.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

hsl.description: HSL Secondary: settings by display name, e.g. Denoise, Blur, Temperature, Tint, Contrast, Sharpen, Saturation

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

additionalProperties.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

vignette.description: Vignette: settings by display name, e.g. Amount, Midpoint, Roundness, Feather

additionalProperties.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

wheels.description: Color Wheels & Match: settings by display name, e.g. the shadow, midtone and highlight wheels and their lightness

name: set_lumetri_color
title: Set Lumetri Color
